I added a new mod, **Tilt card**. The whole page is now a rounded card floating over a dark space background. It tilts up to 12° toward your mouse, eases back to flat when the mouse leaves the window, and a soft glare follows the pointer.

**Depths:** each part of the page sits at its own height above the card. From highest to lowest:
- the Get it and GitHub buttons
- the title
- the tagline
- the "What you need" and "Yours, on your computer" columns
- the footer, just above the card's surface

The robot rides along with the top section.

**What I checked:**
- I moved a fake mouse to two opposite corners and took screenshots. The tilt and the layers look right.
- Clicks still land correctly: the point at the centre of "Get it" and of a footer link still hits that link.
- The mod logged no errors.
- With Gravity mode on (press G), the card goes flat so the falling pieces work as before. I only checked that it flattens, not a full drop.
- Your neon title, jelly buttons, walking robot and fireworks mods are left alone and keep animating.

I couldn't test a real mouse, only simulated movement, so wave yours around to see it live.

To undo it, switch off **Tilt card** in the side panel, or ask me to.
